name: Omarion
notes: B2K's frontman solo, across the Timbaland camp's "Royal Court" and Eric Hudson's productions, 2005–2010. The research gives "56–113; the signature band is 65 half-time (reads 131)", so the half-time material is the base with `halfTime` true and the mode at the signature 65. The band is the entry's own two slow readings, "I'm Tryna" 56 and "Ice Box" 65; its other readings — 96, 105, 107, 113 — are the Eric Hudson cuts the entry describes as "live-feel drums and organ", a different backbeat class, and are not folded into this grid. Three drum deltas from "Timbaland-camp grammar at half-time": "kick clusters of two 16ths" (three to five hits a bar, syncopation 0.66, tresillo lean 0.26, secondary anchor `2a`), "snare/clap on beat 3" pushed 4–10 ms off the grid, and "hats replaced by clicks and reversed ticks, long silences" — a hat lane at 0.1 fill density against a four-lane perc/perc2/reverse/woodblock bed at −4 dB and a 0.3 `beatSkipProb`. The `reverse` lane is authored specifically for the reversed ticks the entry names. Harmony is "two-chord modal beds with a synth-string or bell figure", and the sourced key is E♭ **major** at 65 — "major-mode over a minor-feeling bed" — so the major two-chord families carry real weight against the lane default. "Tenor lead with the melody sitting in a 5th and rhythmic, syncopated phrasing; stacked falsetto on the hook" is a seventeen-semitone register with a riff-dominant contour and a 3–5 pitch motif. The low end is "808 sub with portamento, alternating with the kick; Hudson's records use played bass guitar instead" — two documented bass behaviours, both of them bass parts, so no `drums.bass808` block and a `glideProb` of 0.44. ⚠ Confidence is medium; the research says the drum grammar is camp-level inference. ⚠ Every velocity and density number is INFERRED. ⚠ `session.keys` is part-sourced: the entry names `Eb`, and the remaining values `Bbm`, `Fm`, `Ab`, together with all 4 weights, are INFERRED rather than read from the entry. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 947/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980 (2026-08-17, counter variety floor), and every other lever this gate has was already clean here** — no empty-bar bias, no one-bar phrase length, and no lead allowed to thin below two notes a bar. What was left was the style pool: `generators::counter` can play five answer shapes and this block asked for 2. `octave_echo` is added at weight 2 because the entry already names it — "two-chord modal beds with a synth-string or bell figure; tenor lead with the melody sitting in a 5th and rhythmic, syncopated phrasing; stacked falsetto on the hook" — and the stacked falsetto on the hook is a copy of the lead an octave up, which is `octave_echo`; the bell figure and the synth-string bed are the `bell_echo` and `sustain_pad` already authored. ⚠ The weight is INFERRED; the layer it weights is not.
